author: magicmantheace
description: Universal PC Game Launcher — one library for Steam, Epic, Battle.net and manually added games (Windows x64).
name: universal-game-launcher

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.preload.json
